facts.fact: Clyde & Co reports Egypt's government unveiled its first National Startup Charter in early February 2026, with a startup definition, incentives, and Law No. 6 of 2025 on a simplified tax system for startups.

Clyde & Co reports companies apply to MSMEDA for a Startup Classification Certificate, which gives an official Startup Label in 5 days (fast track) or 14 days (regular), qualifying them for the Charter's incentives.

EGY.note: The document names no hub, incubator or park; Scale-up Champions is a programme, not a hub.
